location_exception_reason: Gazebo tensile structures are custom-fabricated architectural installations sold as supply-and-install services; location of manufacture or seller headquarters does not change the product category or buyer decision criteria. Buyer decisions are driven by design, membrane material (PVC vs PTFE), frame type, and warranty — not origin geography.
biz_exception_reason: Business-type words (Manufacturer, Supplier, Installer, Contractor) are redundant in titles; IndiaMART's seller-type filter already exposes this information independently. Removing 'Manufacturer' or 'Supplier' from a title like 'Gazebo Tensile Structure Manufacturer' leaves the product meaning complete and unchanged.
